patterns.description: Dual NP controller architecture: static library-go vs user-defined runtime controller
Static-managed NetworkPolicy must reconcile spec drift when tampered
User-defined NP reconciler must use compare-before-update to avoid hot loops
User-defined NP controller must watch NetworkPolicy delete for immediate recreate
defaultNetworkPolicy opt-in false for backward compatibility
Per-component traffic matrix: API server, DNS, metrics, webhook, istio gRPC

issues.pattern: Static NP spec drift not corrected without library-go ApplyNetworkPolicy enhancement
issues.eval_implication: Tasks and implementation evals require tamper-and-revert e2e for static NPs
issues.round1_eval_gap: eval-r001-tasks-001 — would catch if NP scenarios added

issues.pattern: Unconditional update caused infinite reconcile loop
issues.eval_implication: Implementation eval must require semantic equality before update

issues.pattern: Missing NetworkPolicy watch delayed recreate by ~8 minutes
issues.eval_implication: Tasks must require Watches on NetworkPolicy for user-defined controller
